segments.sn26.10:1.2: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, rūpassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segments.sn26.10:1.3: Yo vedanāya … yo saññāya … yo saṅkhārānaṃ … yo viññāṇassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segments.sn26.10:1.7: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo.
segments.sn26.10:1.8: Yo vedanāya … yo saññāya … yo saṅkhārānaṃ … yo viññāṇassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segments.sn26.10:1.13: Uppādasaṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ. Tassuddānaṃ – Cakkhu rūpañca viññāṇaṃ, phasso ca vedanāya ca; Saññā ca cetanā taṇhā, dhātu khandhena te dasāti.
